title: ALT/GPT Detection Assay
author: Zumira Carneiro
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.k9ncz5e

steps.title: Prepare combined reagent
steps.instruction: Add 0.300 mL of Reagent 3 to 24 mL of Reagent 1 in a bottle and mix thoroughly. The mixture is stable for 21 days at 2 – 8 °C and for 24 h at 15 – 25 °C if free of chemical or microbial contamination. Optionally, prepare a lower‑volume mixture using 1 part Reagent 3 to 80 parts Reagent 1.

steps.title: Add mixture and sample
steps.instruction: In a test tube labeled “test” or “Calibrator”, add 0.160 mL of the Reagent 1 + Reagent 3 mixture, then add 0.020 mL of the sample or enzyme calibrator. Homogenize the contents and incubate in a water bath set to 37 ± 0.2 °C for 5 minutes (the incubation may be extended up to 30 minutes before the kinetic step).

steps.title: Add Reagent 2 and transfer
steps.instruction: Add 0.040 mL of Reagent 2 to the tube, homogenize, and immediately transfer the reaction mixture to a cuvette maintained at 37 ± 0.2 °C. Allow the cuvette to equilibrate for 1 minute.

steps.title: Measure absorbance kinetics
steps.instruction: Set the spectrophotometer to 340 nm, 10 mm light path, pass band ≤ 2 nm, stray light ≤ 0.1 %, and temperature 37 ± 0.2 °C. Measure the initial absorbance (A₁) and start the timer simultaneously. After exactly 2 minutes, measure the absorbance again (A₂).

steps.title: Calculate ALT activity
steps.instruction: Compute DA/minute = (A₁ – A₂) / 2. Apply the theoretical factor supplied by the manufacturer (reported as 1746 in the protocol; a later statement mentions 1748). ALT activity (U/L) = DA/minute × Factor. If any correlated parameters (wavelength, temperature, cuvette path, etc.) differ, use the calibrator recommended by the reagent manufacturer (e.g., Labtest Diagnostica Calibra series).

steps.title: Perform water blank
steps.instruction: Measure a water blank at 340 nm under the same instrument settings and use it to zero the spectrophotometer before sample measurements.
